major_issues: Mobile: right-side control cluster (Fit/zoom/refresh/%) is cramped and visually ambiguous; tap targets look too small and the % label reads like static text rather than a control/state.

Flow canvas on mobile is not clearly navigable: content appears partially off-screen with no obvious affordance for pan/zoom beyond tiny controls; discoverability for interacting with the diagram is weak.
Several cards contain long technical strings (URLs, hostnames, identifiers) that risk overflow/clipping or force unreadably small type; truncation/wrapping strategy is inconsistent.
medium_issues: Hierarchy in the right column is noisy: many panels have similar weight and spacing, making it hard to identify the top 1–2 most important statuses at a glance.
Contrast for secondary labels (e.g., small meta text like 'Host .15', timestamps, subtle section headings) is borderline on the dark background, especially on mobile.
Inconsistent vertical rhythm: some sections have generous padding while others (notably the metric rows and chips) feel tight, causing density spikes.
Chevron on 'CAPITAL' card suggests collapse but there’s no clear open/closed state styling; icon is subtle and could be mistaken as decoration.
Bottom 'Host/eno1/Blocker' tiles occupy significant vertical space on mobile; they push primary runtime/flow information down.
minor_issues: Event strip ticker at bottom of canvas is very small on mobile; text weight/size reduces readability and looks like a debug overlay rather than a polished component.
Small pill badges (e.g., 'Model gpt-5.2', '2 rounds • completed') have slightly low contrast borders; they blend into the card background.
Some headings use all-caps / small-caps styling that becomes faint at small sizes; legibility suffers.

recommended_changes.change: Increase interactive control hit areas to >= 44px on mobile (zoom +/- , Fit, refresh). Use a consistent control bar with clear grouping and spacing; ensure the % zoom readout is either clearly a label or styled as a button with caret if it opens a menu.

Implement robust long-string handling: apply overflow-wrap:anywhere; word-break:break-word; and/or line-clamp (2–3 lines) with tooltip/title for URLs/identifiers in cards. Ensure no horizontal overflow on 360px widths.

Add explicit diagram interaction affordance for mobile: show a small overlay hint ('Drag to pan • Pinch to zoom') on first load, and/or enable touch panning/zooming directly on the canvas area so users aren’t dependent on tiny buttons.

Strengthen hierarchy in the right column: visually elevate the top status card(s) with stronger header typography and slightly increased spacing between sections; reduce visual parity across all cards (e.g., lighter borders for less-important panels).

Tune dark-theme contrast: increase opacity/brightness of secondary labels and section headings (aim for WCAG-ish contrast). Avoid ultra-low-contrast gray on near-black for timestamps and small meta text.
Normalize vertical rhythm: set consistent card padding (e.g., 16px mobile / 18–20px desktop), consistent gap between stacked cards, and consistent chip spacing to avoid tight clusters.
Make collapsible affordances explicit: if 'CAPITAL' is collapsible, rotate chevron and adjust header background on open/close; if not, remove chevron to reduce confusion.
Reduce mobile footer tile dominance: collapse Host/eno1/Blocker into a single compact row or an accordion to reclaim vertical space for primary runtime content.
Improve event strip readability: increase font-size slightly on mobile, add subtle background/blur and clearer separation so it reads as an intentional component rather than debug text.

stop_reason: Not production-worthy yet due to mobile usability issues (controls/tap targets, diagram navigability) and insufficiently robust handling of long technical strings that can cause overflow/readability problems.
